descriptions.job-0d5cfkv:
DRW is a diversified trading firm with over 3 decades of experience bringing sophisticated technology and exceptional people together to operate in markets around the world. We value autonomy and the ability to quickly pivot to capture opportunities, so we operate using our own capital and trading at our own risk.

Headquartered in Chicago with offices throughout the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Asia, we trade a variety of asset classes including Fixed Income, ETFs, Equities, FX, Commodities and Energy across all major global markets. We have also leveraged our expertise and technology to expand into three non-traditional strategies: real estate, venture capital and cryptoassets.

We operate with respect, curiosity and open minds. The people who thrive here share our belief that it’s not just what we do that matters–it's how we do it. DRW is a place of high expectations, integrity, innovation and a willingness to challenge consensus.

About the Role

DRW is building out its offensive security capability, and we’re looking for a Senior Offensive Security Engineer to lead the charge. In this role, you’ll plan and execute red team engagements, penetration tests, and adversary simulations against our trading infrastructure, corporate environment, and cloud platforms, acting as a trusted adversary who helps us find and fix weaknesses before anyone else does.

You’ll work closely with our security, infrastructure, and trading teams to translate what you find into real improvements, and you’ll help shape the methodology, tooling, and roadmap for offensive security at DRW as the function matures. This is a hands-on, high-trust role for someone who thinks like an attacker, communicates like a partner, and cares about making the firm measurably harder to compromise.

What You'll Do

  • Plan and execute red team engagements and adversary simulations against trading systems, corporate IT, and cloud environments, modeling realistic attacker tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) mapped to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK
  • Conduct penetration tests across networks, web and internal applications, APIs, and cloud infrastructure, and report findings with clear, actionable remediation guidance
  • Design and build custom tooling, scripts, and exploits to emulate adversary behavior, test control effectiveness, and validate detection coverage
  • Partner with the Security Engineering and SOC teams in purple-team exercises to close gaps between what attackers can do and what defenders can see
  • Run social engineering and phishing simulations to assess and improve organizational security awareness
  • Identify, validate, prioritize, and track vulnerabilities and control weaknesses through to remediation in collaboration with infrastructure, platform, and application owners
  • Present engagement results and risk narratives to both technical teams and senior leadership in a way that drives action
  • Stay current on the threat landscape, emerging TTPs, and offensive tooling, and bring that knowledge back into DRW’s defenses
  • Assess the security of AI and LLM-integrated systems, including prompt injection, model manipulation, data poisoning, and abuse of agentic workflows, and work with teams building these systems to harden them
  • Leverage AI-assisted tooling to accelerate reconnaissance, vulnerability discovery, and exploit development, and evaluate new AI-powered offensive techniques as they emerge
  • Help define and mature DRW’s offensive security methodology, standards, and tooling, and mentor other engineers on the security team

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in offensive security, penetration testing, or red teaming, including full engagement lifecycle work: reconnaissance, initial access, privilege escalation, lateral movement, persistence, and exfiltration
  • Strong scripting or programming ability for building and adapting offensive tooling
  • Solid understanding of networking fundamentals, Windows, macOS, and Linux internals, identity providers, and cloud platforms
  • Practical experience with common offensive security tools (e.g., Cobalt Strike, Metasploit, BloodHound, Burp Suite, Nmap) and a track record of building your own when the situation calls for it
  • Working knowledge of the MITRE ATT&CK framework, adversary emulation, and detection evasion techniques, along with enough understanding of defensive controls and tooling to help defenders improve
  • A track record of clear, precise reporting and communication and you can translate technical findings into risk that both engineers and executives understand
  • Experience with smart contract auditing and blockchain security
  • Familiarity with AI/ML security risks, including adversarial attacks on models, prompt injection, and the offensive and defensive implications of LLM-powered tooling
  • A collaborative mindset: you see red teaming as a way to make the whole organization more secure, not just to find flaws

The annual base salary range for this position is $175,000 to $275,000 depending on the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and relevant skill set. The position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. In addition, DRW offers a comprehensive suite of employee benefits including group medical, pharmacy, dental and vision insurance, 401k (with discretionary employer match), short and long-term disability, life and AD&D insurance, health savings accounts, and flexible spending accounts.

For more information about DRW's processing activities and our use of job applicants' data, please view our Privacy Notice at https://drw.com/privacy-notice.

California residents, please review the California Privacy Notice for information about certain legal rights at https://drw.com/california-privacy-notice.

About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role 

As a Product Manager, Growth at Ramp, you’ll drive acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization across our product suite. You’ll identify opportunities to help more businesses discover Ramp, get value from our products, and expand their usage over time.

You’ll work closely with engineers, designers, marketers, and data scientists to develop and execute a growth strategy grounded in customer insight and experimentation. Your scope will include core product experiences and partner-led growth channels, with ownership from identifying an opportunity through launching, measuring, and scaling solutions.

You’ll identify opportunities to use AI to help businesses discover relevant Ramp products, reach value faster, and expand their usage over time. You’ll balance rapid experimentation with the accuracy, transparency, and customer trust required when building financial products.

Please note that this Product Management role will require you to be comfortable with working in-person at one of our NYC or SF offices at least 2 days/week

What You’ll Do

  • Develop and execute a growth product strategy across acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization, helping businesses get more value from Ramp

  • Own the roadmap, priorities, and execution for a defined growth surface area, from identifying opportunities through launching, measuring, and scaling solutions

  • Lead the ideation, development, and launch of growth experiences, including AI-powered approaches to onboarding, product discovery, recommendations, and cross-sell

  • Partner with engineering, design, marketing, and data science to deliver high-impact initiatives across core product experiences and partner-led growth channels

  • Conduct customer research and analyze product metrics and feedback to understand where finance teams encounter friction and identify opportunities to improve adoption

  • Define and track growth KPIs, design controlled experiments where feasible, and use results to distinguish incremental impact from underlying trends

  • Evaluate AI-powered experiences for both growth impact and quality, including accuracy, relevance, and reliability; balance rapid iteration with safeguards for sensitive financial data, transparency, and customer control

  • Turn successful experiments into durable product improvements and contribute to the practices that help Ramp’s product management function scale

What You Need

  • BA/BS in mathematics, technical, or analytical field

  • Minimum 4 years of product management experience, building technical products from ideation to launch

  • Data-Driven Mindset – Fluency in crafting data-driven narratives. You enjoy writing SQL to answer your own questions and thrive on leveraging data to shape and communicate a strategic vision.

  • Slope - We value slope over intercept; We’re looking for a high-growth team member who can be a future leader at Ramp

  • Leadership & Collaboration – Proven ability to build alignment across cross-functional teams, inspire stakeholders, and lead initiatives from strategy through execution.

  • Passion for AI, shown through hands-on building, prototyping, or side projects, and staying current on research and tools.

  • Fluency with modern prototyping tools (e.g. Cursor, Codex, Claude Code) and comfort with design/collaboration environments like Figma and Git.

Benefits available to all full-time Ramp employees (Global)

  • Flexible PTO

  • Centralized home-office equipment ordering

  • Health and wellness stipend

  • Budget for intra-office travel

  • Weekly coffee stipend

United States

  • 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents

  • One Medical annual membership

  • 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

  • Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

  • Pet insurance

  • In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

  • Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)

Canada

  • Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life

  • Life, AD&D, and disability coverage

  • Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)

  • Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP)

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay

  • Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health

United Kingdom

Referral Instructions

Other notices

Description

Role location and working style: 

This is position is based in Limassol, Cyprus with an in-office and hybrid set up. Remote set up is not possible.

About eToro: 

eToro is the platform where you can trade, invest, save, and spend. Founded in 2007 with the vision of a world where everyone can trade and invest in a simple and transparent way, we've built a regulated, Nasdaq-listed platform used by millions of people in 75 countries. 

We believe there is power in shared knowledge. By combining the collective intelligence of our community with AI-powered tools, we've created a collaborative investment community designed to help you grow your knowledge and wealth.  

On eToro, you can hold a range of traditional and innovative assets and choose how you invest: trade directly, invest in a portfolio, copy other investors, or invest with an AI agent. Visit our Media Centre for the latest news. 

You can find out more about eToro here. 

Role Summary

This role is ideal for someone who is analytical, detail-oriented, comfortable reviewing complex customer activity, and interested in using AI, automation, and technology to improve day-to-day investigative work. 

﻿What will you be doing? 

  • Monitor and analyze customer transactions and account activity to identify unusual or suspicious behavior
  • Investigate alerts generated by transaction monitoring and fraud detection systems
  • Assess customer activity against their profile, expected behavior, occupation/business activity, geographic exposure, payment methods, and transaction history. 
  • Conduct Source of Funds (SOF) and Source of Wealth (SOW) reviews, assessing supporting documents and determining whether the information provided is reasonable and consistent with the customer's activity
  • Identify potential indicators of money laundering, fraud, account misuse, mule activity, third-party funding, structuring, layering, and other financial crime risks
  • Perform holistic customer reviews using available KYC/CDD information, transaction history, previous alerts, supporting documentation, and other relevant information
  • Decide whether cases can be closed or require further investigation or escalation, applying a clear risk-based approach
  • Document investigations, findings, decisions, and rationale clearly and accurately
  • Escalate suspicious or high-risk activity to the relevant AML, Fraud, Compliance, or Financial Crime teams
  • Support the preparation of detailed investigation summaries and supporting evidence for escalated cases
  • Work closely with other teams, including AML, Fraud, Compliance, Payments, Risk, and Customer Support
  • Identify emerging fraud and AML patterns, trends, and typologies and share relevant findings with the wider team
  • Provide feedback on monitoring rules, alerts, thresholds, and processes to help improve detection of quality and efficiency
  • Use approved AI, automation, and analytical tools to support transaction analysis, information gathering, case summarization, pattern identification, and investigation workflows
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and improve the efficiency and quality of the team's day-to-day work 

Requirements

  • Strong analytical and investigative skills with the ability to identify patterns, inconsistencies, and risk indicators
  • Ability to assess information objectively and make clear, well-reasoned decisions
  • Strong attention to detail and a high standard of case documentation
  • Good written and verbal communication skills
  • Comfortable learning new tools from scratch (including transaction monitoring systems, case management tools, Excel, and other analytical platforms)
  • Good AI and digital literacy, with an interest in using technology to improve investigative work and operational efficiency
  • A proactive and curious mindset, with a willingness to challenge existing processes and suggest improvements

Our Hiring Philosophy: 

At eToro, AI is changing how we build, work and make decisions, and our hiring approach reflects that. We are building an AI-first organisation where people are encouraged to use AI thoughtfully. 

That starts with how we hire. Throughout our recruitment process, we may use AI-enabled tools, including interview notetakers and other technologies that help us capture information accurately, improve consistency and create a better experience for candidates and interviewers. These tools support our feedback and assessment outcomes. Hiring decisions remain grounded in running fair and consistent interview processes, human judgement, critical thinking, and thorough evaluation of experience, ability and motivation that are aligned to our business and role requirements. 

We also want candidates to be comfortable working with AI. Depending on the role, we may explore how you use AI tools in your day-to-day work, how you think about their opportunities and limitations, and how you would contribute to eToro’s continued AI build-out. 

For us, being AI-first is not about replacing human judgement. It is about combining human expertise, creativity and accountability with technology that helps us do our best work and accelerate our growth. In the end, that's what we're hiring for: human insight, supercharged by AI.

descriptions.job-0l3rqzj:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

About the Role

Square is looking for a senior operations leader to own US seller onboarding operations across first-party and vendor-supported delivery motions. Reporting to the Head of Global Onboarding Operations, this leader will translate global onboarding strategy into US operating plans, manage multiple teams and workstreams, and drive measurable improvements in seller activation, time-to-value, service quality, workforce productivity, and cost-to-serve.

This role requires broad operational expertise, strong cross-functional influence, and the ability to make high-quality decisions in ambiguous situations. The right candidate can operate independently on significant assignments, build scalable operating mechanisms, and manage leaders responsible for day-to-day execution across a large and complex market.

What You Will Own

US Onboarding Operations

  • Own US onboarding execution from post-sale handoff through go-live across applicable seller segments, channels, and delivery models.
  • Establish operational objectives, work plans, staffing models, and performance requirements for US first-party and vendor-supported teams.
  • Manage coverage, scheduling, routing, utilization, quality, escalations, and service-level adherence across US operations.
  • Drive accountability for US market performance while implementing global onboarding standards and operating cadences.

Operational Excellence and Performance

  • Improve key metrics including activation, time-to-value, CSAT, SLA adherence, utilization, and cost-to-serve.
  • Use data, frontline insights, and business reviews to identify risks, root causes, and improvement opportunities.
  • Lead process redesign, tooling improvements, automation opportunities, and playbook development for US onboarding workflows.
  • Utilize AI to enhance seller outcomes and improve internal workflows

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner with Sales, Product, Finance, and regional GTM teams to improve seller onboarding outcomes.
  • Influence senior stakeholders on priorities, tradeoffs, resource needs, and operational changes affecting US onboarding.
  • Represent US onboarding operations in cross-functional forums and translate operational data into clear recommendations.

Team Leadership

  • Manage multiple teams, managers, or workstreams within US onboarding operations.
  • Coach and develop operational leaders, raising the bar for judgment, execution, accountability, and seller empathy.
  • Build a culture of ownership, continuous improvement, and high-quality service delivery across distributed teams.

What We Are Looking For

  • 12+ years of progressive operations leadership experience, ideally in technology, fintech, commerce, SaaS implementation, customer success operations, field operations, or scaled services delivery.
  • Experience managing multiple teams or departments with responsibility for staffing, quality, cost, and performance.
  • Strong understanding of workforce planning, capacity management, service delivery operations, and performance management.
  • Experience leading through subordinate managers and influencing senior cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical and financial acumen, including KPI management, budget inputs, forecasting, and cost-to-serve improvement.
  • Ability to operate independently in ambiguous situations while aligning with senior leadership on objectives and outcomes.
  • Experience with vendor-supported operations, field teams, remote onboarding, or blended delivery models preferred.
  • Clear communication, strong judgment, and the ability to gain alignment in sensitive or complex situations.
  • Experience improving workflows and customer outcomes using AI

Why This Role Matters

Seller onboarding is one of the most important moments in the Square journey. The speed, quality, and consistency of a seller’s first experience directly shape activation, retention, satisfaction, and long-term value. This role helps ensure Square can scale onboarding globally while improving seller outcomes and operating efficiency.

descriptions.job-068nr4v:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Builder Experience Team makes it easier for Stripe’s product teams to build the right products, ship them with confidence, and help users realize value from them.

In order to build a great product, product teams must develop a deep understanding of users, shape and test ideas, coordinate across functions, navigate launch requirements, identify risks, gather feedback, and manage products after launch. Today, many of these workflows are fragmented, manual, or built around processes and tools that predate recent advances in AI.

We are a small, AI-native team reimagining how Stripe builds, ships, and ramps products. We experiment with new approaches across AI agents, automation, and process—and scale the ones that work. Our initial areas of focus include reinventing launch readiness from gates into guidelines, giving product teams richer and more timely context, and shortening the feedback loops between builders, users, Sales, and Support.

Our users are Stripe’s product managers, engineers, designers, researchers – and we help to simplify the interactions with the cross-functional teams that help bring products to market. We work closely with teams including all of our business unit PMs, Product Operations, and Kai, Stripe’s internal AI platform.

What you'll do

We’re looking for product-minded engineers who want to rethink how products get built—not simply digitize existing processes. You’ll identify high-friction parts of Stripe’s product-development lifecycle, rapidly prototype new approaches, put them in the hands of real teams, and turn the strongest experiments into scaled solutions used by every product team at Stripe.

This is a hands-on role with broad product and technical scope. You’ll work across the stack, combining traditional software engineering with emerging AI capabilities. You’ll operate in ambiguous problem spaces where the right product, interface, and technical architecture must be discovered together.

You will:

  • Design and build tools that help Stripe teams shape better products, ship with greater speed and confidence, and learn from users more quickly.
  • Develop AI-native workflows and agents that synthesize context, automate repetitive work, surface risks, and help builders make better decisions.
  • Own projects end to end: identify high-value problems, develop prototypes, test them with users, measure their impact, and scale the approaches that work.
  • Work across backend systems, data sources, internal platforms, and polished user-facing experiences.
  • Partner directly with product managers, engineers, designers, researchers, and cross-functional teams to understand how work happens in practice.
  • Integrate with platforms such as Kai and Compass while identifying where new foundational capabilities are needed.
  • Apply strong judgment to the use of sensitive internal context, including appropriate attention to security, privacy, permissions, and user trust.
  • Help define how the team operates, including its technical foundations, product-development practices, and standards for experimentation and quality.
  • Contribute to the team’s roadmap by identifying systemic sources of friction and opportunities to improve Stripe’s product-development lifecycle.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 5+ years of backend and/or full-stack software development experience
  • Demonstrated technical experience leading the design and delivery of new product experiences from prototype to production
  • Strong full-stack engineering skills, including experience building reliable backend services and polished user-facing product experiences.
  • Ability to operate effectively in high-ambiguity environments: framing problems, experimenting & adjusting, making right-sized technical decisions, and creating an actionable path forward.
  • Excellent cross-functional and cross-organizational collaboration skills, with the ability to align teams with different systems, priorities, and constraints.
  • Strong engineering judgment around system reliability, operational excellence, security, and maintainability.
  • A product-minded approach to engineering, with a focus on delivering meaningful outcomes for users and the business.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with Java, Ruby, and/or TypeScript. We care more about strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn than expertise in a particular language or framework.
  • Experience delivering user facing products at Stripe (Payments, MM, RevSuite, etc), or experience delivering user facing products pre-dating Stripe. 
  • Experience working on 0→1 products or taking new capabilities from concept through launch and iteration.
descriptions.job-0ukry5b:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.


Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Payward Services is an enterprise infrastructure platform that enables companies to seamlessly integrate trading, payments, funding, and digital asset services through a single unified system. It provides coordinated liquidity, custody, compliance, risk management, and settlement capabilities, reducing operational complexity for fintechs, banks, brokerages, and payment providers.

Payward's Payments & Blockchain team owns the first and last mile of every dollar that moves in or out of its products. That means dozens of banking partners, PSPs and local rails powering deposits and withdrawals for millions of users.

The team is looking for a product manager to shape the future of this platform, from the architecture underneath to the API layer internal clients build on. At the center is Payward's in-house PSP: a scalable, multi-tenant payments backend with hosted pages, SDKs, embedded components and direct APIs, so any Payward business can plug in and reach pay-in and payout rails worldwide.

 

The opportunity

  • Own the product vision and roadmap for the Payward payments platform, covering both the shared backend and the integration surfaces internal clients build on (hosted pages, SDKs, embedded components and direct APIs)

  • Map requirements across internal clients and use them to evolve the platform's vision and capabilities so it serves a growing range of use cases

  • Partner with engineering to turn the target vision into a sequenced, high-impact roadmap, with milestones every client team can plan against

  • Prioritize across competing client needs, make the trade-offs visible, and say no with a clear rationale

  • Shape the client experience end to end, from first conversation to go-live, so teams can adopt the platform without heavy hand-holding

  • Work with the banking and partnerships teams so each new PSP or bank integration is built once on the platform and reaches every Payward business

  • Bring compliance, risk and legal requirements across Payward's entities and jurisdictions into the roadmap early, before they become launch blockers

  • Set and track platform success metrics, such as time to launch a rail for an existing client, time for a new client to go live, share of rails available through the platform, and payment success rates

 
 

What you bring

  • 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in a platform, API or infrastructure role where your customers were other internal teams or developers

  • Working knowledge of payments: pay-ins and payouts, PSPs and acquirers, bank rails (ACH, SEPA, Faster Payments, SWIFT and local methods), and how money flows between them

  • Strong technical fluency. You can read an RFC, challenge an architecture decision, and write an API spec that engineers respect

  • Experience shipping developer-facing products such as APIs, SDKs, or embeddable UI components

  • Clear, structured writing. You turn complex system designs into docs that product, compliance and business stakeholders can all act on

  • Skill at managing many stakeholders with different priorities, and building alignment without direct authority

  • Comfort working with data to set goals and measure platform adoption and performance

 
 

Nice to haves

Applying to Paxos? Our only careers site is paxos.com/careers, and we only recruit via @paxos.com email. Details below.
___

About Paxos

Today’s financial infrastructure is archaic, expensive, inefficient and risky — supporting a system that leaves out more people than it lets in. So we’re rebuilding it.

We’re on a mission to open the world’s financial system to everyone by enabling the instant movement of any asset, any time, in a trustworthy way. For over a decade, we’ve built blockchain infrastructure that tokenizes, custodies, trades and settles assets for the world's leading financial institutions, like PayPal, Venmo, Mastercard, Interactive Brokers and Charles Schwab.

About the team
The Security team at Paxos protects the cloud infrastructure, crypto systems, endpoints, and network that our regulated financial platform runs on. You'll join the Detection and Response function, working alongside our 24x7 SOC, which handles first-line triage, and partnering with Product Security teams to validate that our coverage holds up against real attacker techniques.

About the role

The Detection and Response Engineer at Paxos serves as a builder of the detections, hunts, and automations that protect our cloud infrastructure, crypto systems, endpoints, and network. You will write detections as code and automate response, and act as a purple teamer, emulating attacks alongside our Product Security teams to confirm our detections work. Our 24x7 SOC handles first-line triage, so your focus is the detection engineering, threat hunting, and validation that make our coverage effective. Strong hands-on investigation skills are expected, but they support this work rather than define it.

What you'll do

  • Detection Coverage & Quality: Ship production-grade detections as code with measurable signal improvements—reducing false positives and closing gaps identified in purple team exercises.

  • Validated Defenses: Run purple team exercises with other teams to confirm detection effectiveness and identify blind spots.

  • Threat Hunting Program: Execute proactive hunts based on threat intelligence and convert findings into new detections and documented IOCs/TTPs.

  • Operational Efficiency: Build automations to accelerate investigation and triage; create and maintain runbooks and incident write-ups that make response consistent and repeatable across the team.

  • Detection Stack: Identify gaps and integrate best-in-class tools that increase team effectiveness and visibility across endpoints, cloud, network, and signing systems.

About you

  • You bring 3+ years of experience in security operations, detection engineering, offensive security testing, or a related security engineering role, and you're comfortable owning tickets and incidents end-to-end within established runbooks, escalating clearly when you hit the edge of your knowledge.

  • You have hands-on experience investigating and responding to security threats across endpoints, cloud environments, and network telemetry, using existing tooling (SIEM, EDR, ticketing systems) effectively rather than needing to build it from scratch.

  • You bring strong analytical judgment and a calm, methodical approach to triaging alerts and driving incidents through resolution, and you flag gaps in process or coverage as you find them.

  • You have hands-on experience tuning detections in SIEM and EDR platforms to improve signal quality and reduce false positives, and can write or adapt detection rules from an existing template or pattern.

  • You have used adversary-emulation or purple-team tooling to validate that your detections actually fire, and you understand common attack paths well enough to know what a given detection should — and shouldn't — catch.

  • You are a builder who looks for opportunities to automate repetitive work, including using AI and scripting (Python/Bash) to speed up investigations.

  • You communicate clearly within your immediate team, contribute meaningfully to post-incident write-ups, and act on feedback that sharpens your investigative and detection work.

  • You are prepared to participate in an on-call rotation and document incidents clearly and effectively to support continuous improvement.

Important Notice for Paxos Applicants
Fraudulent accounts sometimes pose as Paxos recruiters on LinkedIn and other platforms, and fake websites sometimes impersonate our careers site. These scammers attempt to deceive applicants into paying for job opportunities or providing personal financial information.

To verify a legitimate Paxos opportunity:

  • Our only official careers site is paxos.com/careers

  • We only use @paxos.com email addresses

  • We never ask for payment or financial details to apply, interview, or work here

  • For technical roles, we do not perform a coding interview without prior screening by our engineering team

Thanks for your interest in Paxos!

Block builds simple, powerful tools that make progress towards an economy that’s truly open to all.

Each of our brands unlocks different aspects of the economy for more people. Square makes commerce and financial services accessible to sellers. Cash App is the easy way to spend, send, and store money. Afterpay is transforming the way customers manage their spending over time. TIDAL is a music platform that empowers artists to thrive as entrepreneurs. Bitkey is a simple self-custody wallet built for bitcoin. Proto is a suite of bitcoin mining products and services. Together, we’re helping build a financial system that is open to everyone. Join us.

The Role

The AI & DX (Developer Experience) Analytics team exists to measure and improve Block's developer experience and investment in AI. We turn raw engineering signals (agent session data, pull request and CI activity, and AI spend) into reporting and analysis that shape leadership's AI investment decisions, and drive improvement in AI ROI and developer experience. Your work will be the trusted source of truth that engineers and executives use to decide where AI investment is working and where to redirect it.

We're hiring a Senior Analytics Engineer to own parts of that pipeline end to end. This is a broad, high-visibility role with a lot of white space: you will instrument new telemetry at the source and build production pipelines that turn it into governed data, then turn that governed data into executive-facing reporting and the analysis that surfaces concrete opportunities to improve AI ROI and developer experience. You'll also help pioneer one of the most consequential open problems in the industry right now: measuring the productivity impact of an increasingly AI- and agent-augmented engineering workforce, where there is no textbook answer and real room to set the standard. You'll define new metrics and craft the visual narrative — the charts, dashboards, and presentation materials — that make them land with an executive audience. AI-first workflows are central to how this team operates and critical to succeeding in this role: using AI coding agents is a default part of how you build and maintain pipelines and dashboards. You'll excel in this role if you're as comfortable defining and visualizing a brand new executive-facing metric from a messy signal as you are debugging why a pipeline silently stalled overnight.

You Will

Instrumentation & Telemetry:

  • Instrument and extend the raw telemetry captured about AI usage, code changes, CI/CD activity, and spend — building new data capture, not only transforming what already exists. This is core to the role, as evolving AI tools and increased AI adoption constantly creates new signals that need to be captured.
  • Partner with data engineers on production ETL pipelines that land that telemetry into governed tables, with the freshness monitoring, backfills, and alerting that keep it trustworthy, rather than a one-off script.
  • Define new metrics out of ambiguous or evolving signals, and earn stakeholder trust in a new number by validating and reconciling it until it holds up.

Dashboards & analysis:

  • Build and ship the executive-facing dashboards and visualizations that turn governed metrics into decision-ready reporting — with the polish and precision a room of executives will scrutinize.
  • Run the analysis that a new chart or metric needs and anticipate questions that an executive audience will ask, then bring senior stakeholders a recommendation, not just a number, and defend the methodology behind both.
  • Translate complex, technical findings into a clear narrative: the headline chart and the one sentence that makes an executive act on it.

Across both:

  • Use AI coding agents as a default part of how you write, test, and maintain data pipelines, dashboards, and analyses.
  • Partner across data engineering, applied AI, and data science teams to keep telemetry connected end to end — the raw signal you capture directly feeds the session classifiers, not just the dashboards you build.
  • Turn what the data shows into action: flag where AI spend isn't paying off or where developer friction is most costly, and push the tooling, process, or investment changes that address it.
  • Push the industry-frontier work of quantifying AI and agent productivity impact — there's no established playbook, and this team sets one.

Qualifications

You are: 

  • Self-sufficient across the full analytics loop: instrumentation, pipeline building, metric definition, and dashboards — not someone who hands off past the query.
  • At home in messy, evolving telemetry, with the judgment to know when a new number is right and when it needs a second look before an executive sees it.
  • A strong product thinker: you get at what a stakeholder actually needs from a metric or chart, not just what they asked for.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity on a genuinely unsolved problem — measuring AI/agent productivity impact — and motivated to go set the standard rather than wait for one.
  • An exceptional communicator, able to defend a metric's methodology and a chart's framing directly to senior stakeholders.
  • Thoughtful about using AI coding agents in your own craft: fast to build with them, and rigorous about evaluating what they produce rather than taking it on faith.

You have:

  • 8+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering, or business intelligence, owning production data pipelines and insights end to end.
  • Strong SQL and Python, with hands-on experience building and operating data pipelines against a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake.
  • Experience partnering with engineering teams to instrument new event or telemetry data, not only transforming what's already captured.
  • Experience building dashboards or internal tools that non-technical stakeholders rely on to make decisions.
  • Comfort with git, CI/CD systems, and debugging production pipeline failures such as retries and backfills.

Even better:

  • Experience with a metrics-governance or semantic-layer system, such as a metrics store, dbt semantic layer, or LookML.

Technologies we use and teach:

  • SQL (Snowflake), Python, TypeScript and React, Git, CI/CD pipelines, a governed metrics store, AI coding agents, and LLM-based classification tooling.

descriptions.job-0ynagyn:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

The Developer Infrastructure org is the engine behind Robinhood's entire engineering organization — a collection of tightly integrated teams whose collective mission is to make every engineer at Robinhood faster, more reliable, and exponentially more productive. The org spans four major teams: DevX (Developer Experience), TestX (Test Infrastructure), Backend Platform, and Mobile Platform. DevX owns Robinhood's monorepo and Bazel-based build infrastructure — the critical layer between a developer writing code and that code being ready to ship — along with the company's full CI/CD pipeline and remote build execution cluster. TestX owns the infrastructure behind Robinhood's entire test experience: the integration test environments, and personal development environments that serve as miniature simulations of the full Robinhood system, giving engineers a safe, isolated space to test their code end-to-end before it ever touches production. Backend Platform and Mobile Platform own the core language runtimes, libraries, IDEs, and developer toolchains across Python, Go, TypeScript, Swift, and Android. Together, these teams share a single north star: leveraging AI and agentic systems to fundamentally transform Robinhood's software development lifecycle — making every engineer dramatically more productive and the entire org a force multiplier for the business.

As the Senior Staff Software Developer, Developer Infrastructure, you are the technical driver of this entire org — the Uber Tech Lead unifying DevX, TestX, Backend Platform, and Mobile Platform under one cohesive technical vision. Your primary focus will be DevX, owning the technical direction of Robinhood's most critical build and developer infrastructure. But your influence stretches far wider: you will be a driving force in weaving AI and agentic development deeply into every layer of the software development lifecycle — from intelligent code review and automated build pipelines to agentic coding systems that multiply what each engineer can ship. This is a rare opportunity to shape not just how Robinhood builds software today, but what engineering velocity looks like for the entire industry!

This role is based in our Toronto office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you’ll do

  • Own the technical direction and roadmap for the Developer Infrastructure org — serving as the Uber Tech Lead across DevX, TestX, Backend Platform, and Mobile Platform, unifying four engineering teams under a shared technical vision
  • Lead and evolve Robinhood's Bazel-based monorepo build infrastructure — own the remote build execution cluster, drive language-agnostic build optimization across Python, Go, TypeScript, and more, and ensure fast, stable feedback loops for the entire engineering org
  • Scale CI/CD pipelines to support thousands of daily builds with speed, safety, and reliability — overseeing GitHub repository configurations, pre-merge checks, and test execution infrastructure across the company
  • Drive the vision for TestX — the test infrastructure and environments that power Robinhood's entire test experience, including integration test environments and personal development environments that simulate the full Robinhood system so engineers can test safely and confidently
  • Champion the integration of AI and agentic systems across the full software development lifecycle — driving initiatives that use intelligent automation and coding agents to multiply developer velocity, improve code quality, and accelerate the pace of innovation across the org
  • Set technical standards across Backend Platform and Mobile Platform — owning the vision for core language runtimes, libraries, IDE tooling, and developer environment security across Python, Go, TypeScript, Swift, and Android
  • Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to define and execute a long-term developer infrastructure roadmap that embeds AI as a force multiplier at every layer of the SDLC

What you bring

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience with a demonstrated track record at the Senior Staff, Principal, or Distinguished Engineer level — you've set technical direction at the org or company level, not just the team level
  • Deep expertise with Bazel and large-scale monorepo build systems — you've owned remote build execution infrastructure at scale and understand the architectural tradeoffs deeply
  • Experience building and operating CI/CD pipelines at massive scale — across thousands of daily builds, multiple programming languages, and complex pre-merge pipeline logic
  • Fluency in Go and/or Python; broad familiarity with TypeScript, Swift, or Android development environments is a strong signal
  • Strong background with distributed systems, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred) — you understand the full stack of developer tooling from IDE to deployment
  • Experience with test infrastructure, integration test environments, or developer environment platforms — you understand what a great test experience looks like at scale
  • Genuine interest in or hands-on experience with agentic AI systems, automated code review, or AI-driven developer velocity programs — you have a clear point of view on how AI will reshape the software development lifecycle and want to be the one building it
  • Exceptional technical leadership, communication, and influence skills — you've unified cross-functional engineering teams around a shared vision and driven ambiguous, org-spanning initiatives to completion
  • Track record of mentoring senior engineers and elevating the technical bar across large, diverse engineering organizations

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career
  • Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, and equity ownership
  • Top tier benefits to fuel your work, including supplemental health insurance, ancillary insurance, and mental health support programs
  • Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not 
  • Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible employer-paid benefits spending account expenses beyond traditional benefits such as wellness, childcare, learning, and more.
  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, paid volunteer time off, parental leave, and more!
  • Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. 
  • Monthly commuter stipend to help offset in-office commuting costs

descriptions.job-1qm8ysf:
About Aspora

People on the move deserve a bank that moves with them. Since 2022, Aspora has been building a borderless financial operating system that makes money as mobile and transparent as its users.

Backed by influential venture capitalists like Sequoia Capital, Greylock Partners, Hummingbird Ventures, Y Combinator & Global Founders Capital. We're a team of 150+ across India, the UK, the UAE, EU and the US, working with extreme ownership, radical candour, and an obsession with customer impact.

We celebrate builders who question assumptions, ship fast, and turn regulatory complexity into elegant solutions. If you’re driven to redefine what global banking can be, we’d love to build the future with you.

What You Will Do

  1. Team & Technical Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and support engineers while setting clear technical direction for the pod.

  • Build a high-ownership, growth-oriented culture through effective feedback, coaching, and collaboration.

  • Contribute to key architectural discussions, technical decisions, and hands-on problem-solving with senior engineers.

  1. Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Product to challenge requirements, drive clarity, and ensure alignment on priorities.

  • Partner with Support & Operations to understand customer issues and operational realities, feeding these insights into planning and improvements.

  • Communicate progress, risks, and decisions transparently with stakeholders and leadership.

  1. Execution, Delivery & Ownership

  • Drive end-to-end execution by planning, prioritising, and tracking engineering work.

  • Maintain strong development velocity by removing blockers and enabling smooth workflows.

  • Uphold high engineering standards and ensure the pod builds reliable, well-tested, and operationally sound systems.

  • Own pod-level metrics (e.g., latency, success rates, efficiency) and use data-driven insights to continuously refine execution and delivery.

Who You Are

  • 6–9 years of experience in software engineering.

  • Proven track record of transitioning from individual contributor to people manager.

  • Thrives in fast-paced, high-growth startup environments.

  • Combines hands-on technical expertise with effective team leadership and mentorship.

  • You excel at making decisions that serve business goals while nurturing the development of your people.

  • We are language-agnostic and value strong engineering fundamentals over specific tech stacks.

Why Aspora?

  • Lead some of the most critical pods with direct impact on customer trust and business growth.

  • Blend hands-on engineering with leadership—ideal for someone who enjoys both building and shaping teams.

  • High ownership, autonomy, and the opportunity to define engineering culture from the ground up.

  • Work in a fast-paced environment with sharp cross-functional partners and supportive leadership.

Perks and Benefits

  • Competitive compensation and equity, aligned with experience, impact and market standards.

  • Learning & development support, including professional development budgets and learning stipends.

  • Wellness and team engagement programs to support work-life integration and collaboration.

descriptions.job-0jm31wf:
会社紹介

ビットバンクはSBIグループの一員として新たな成長を目指す、暗号資産専業のスタートアップ企業です。
「ビットコインの技術で、世界中にあらゆる価値を流通させる」をミッションに暗号資産技術の応用によって、人々の生活にビットコインが浸透し普及することを目指しています。
180名を超える社員のうち、20代〜30代のメンバーが約70％と若手中心ですが、40代以上の経験豊富なベテランも多数在籍しています。
同じビジョンを共有するメンバーが、それぞれの専門性を活かしながら、日々挑戦と成長を重ねています。私たちは当社が掲げるVision、Missionに共感し、そして3つのValuesを大切にしています。

■主なサービス
【bitbank. cc】
ビットコインをはじめ幅広く取り揃えた豊富な銘柄を取り扱っており、シンプルで軽量なデザインに加え、高い機能性を備えたスマートな取引所です。
また、金融庁の認可を受けた暗号資産交換業者として、安全性と信頼性の高い取引環境を実現しています

■子会社情報
【Bitbank Ventures合同会社（Bitbank Ventures）】
Bitbank Ventures株式会社は、ビットバンク株式会社の100%出資により設立された投資子会社です。
暗号資産やブロックチェーンによるインターネット上の新たな価値移転の可能性に加え、AI技術の進化により注目される「AI × クリプト」領域など、将来を見据えた先端技術の動向を的確に捉えながら、未来の社会を支える革新的な取り組みを支援することを目的としています。

Vision

オープンでフェアな社会を実現する

Mission

ビットコインの技術で、世界中にあらゆる価値を流通させる

Values

【 Integrity 】
何事にも真摯に取り組み、関わるすべての人を尊重する。
率直に意見し、言行に責任をもち、誠実であることを誇る。

【 Challenge 】
あらゆるチャンスを素早く捉え、失敗を恐れず、自らチャレンジし続ける。

【 One team 】
仲間を信じ、仲間と取り組み、仲間と共に成長する。

主なトピック

  • 2026年10月、SBIホールディングス株式会社の完全子会社化
  • 2026年1月、本社オフィスを「東京ミッドタウン八重洲」へ移転
  • 子育てに合わせた多様な働き方を可能にする労働条件の整備や取り組みが評価され、「子育てサポート企業」として「くるみん認定」を取得
  • 3年連続で「健康経営優良法人2025」に認定

募集ポジション

プラットフォームエンジニア（Platform Engineer）

募集背景

ビットバンクは「ビットコインの技術で、世界中にあらゆる価値を流通させる」というミッションのもと、国内トップクラスの規模を持つ暗号資産取引所として成長を続けています。

暗号資産取引所は24時間365日の高い稼働率が求められ、Webサービスとしての開発スピードと金融機関としてのセキュリティ・ガバナンスの両立が不可欠です。当社では各開発チームが自らインフラを構築する体制をとっており、インフラチームは全社で利用する共通基盤の整備を通じて、開発チームの生産性と安全性を支える Platform Engineering を推進しています。
しかし、開発チームの自律性と開発速度をさらに高めるためには、基盤の標準化やセルフサービス化を一層進めていく必要があります。

今後は開発環境のセルフサービス化やオブザーバビリティの推進、GitHub 運用の標準化に加え、金融機関として求められるセキュリティ水準の継続的な強化など、開発チーム全体の生産性とセキュリティ水準をさらに引き上げてまいります。

これらの取り組みを加速させるため、AWS を中心としたクラウド基盤の設計・構築に強みを持ち、開発者体験の向上を自ら推進できる Platform Engineer を募集します。

仕事内容

（雇入直後）

  • 開発者体験の標準化
    • GitHub Actions の共通テンプレート整備とリポジトリ初期構成の標準化
    • Amazon EKS 上のセルフホストランナーを活用した CI/CD 基盤の運用・改善
    • 社内向けインフラ設計標準ガイドラインの策定・運用
    • 開発チームと連携し、インフラ領域の課題解決と推進改善
  • 開発環境のセルフサービス化
    • オンデマンドな開発環境構築基盤の設計・実装
    • 複数 AWS アカウント・リポジトリにまたがる依存関係の整理と自動化パイプラインの構築
    • CloudFormation / CDK を用いた IaC 化によるポータビリティと再現性の向上
  • AI エージェントによるインフラ業務の効率化
    • 開発者自身が AI エージェントを活用しインフラのトラブルシューティングを効率的に行える仕組みづくり
    • AI エージェント が参照するコンテキスト（Rules, ドキュメント）の整備
  • AWS インフラのセキュリティ強化
    • 開発チームが安全にデリバリーできるセキュリティガードレールの設計・運用
    • AWS WAF をはじめとするアプリケーション防御策の設計・運用
    • AWS Organization を含めたインフラストラクチャ全般のセキュリティ運用・コンプライアンス対応
    • JIT（Just-In-Time）権限管理による最小権限アクセスの実現
    • セキュリティ関連サービスの検出結果をもとにしたリスク対応
    • 金融業界特有の規制要件に基づく継続的な改善
  • FinOps を通じたクラウドコストの最適化
    • RI / Savings Plans の継続的な購入・見直しによるコスト削減
    • Looker によるコスト可視化の高度化および定期レポートの設計・配信

（変更の範囲）

  • 同上

開発環境

  • インフラ
    • コンピューティング
      • Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service
      • AWS Fargate
      • AWS Lambda
      • Amazon EC2
    • OS
      • Amazon Linux
      • RedHat Enterprise Linux
    • セキュリティ
      • AWS WAF
      • AWS Shield Advanced
    • IaC
      • CloudFormation, CDK, Terraform
    • CI/CD

descriptions.job-1hh5nxb:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Build, improve, diagnose, fix, and measure things. Have outsized impact in your role supporting a rapidly scaling sales organization! The GTM sales team at Stripe works with new and existing businesses of all shapes and sizes. As a member of the Central Sales Strategy and Operations team, you’ll be responsible for overall productivity and effectiveness of the sales organization, partnering closely with senior sales leadership and the broader sales team to provide insights and analysis on core business performance metrics and drive key strategic sales initiatives.

What you’ll do

Partnering closely with the GTM leadership team, regional sales leaders to support sales teams, owning the in-depth monitoring and tracking of the business metrics, creation of key intelligence and insights to accelerate growth. 

Partner with key cross-functional stakeholders, including but not limited to Marketing, Finance & Strategy, Data Science, Seller Systems, and Strategic Operations to streamline and optimize our internal processes and run-the-business and planning deliverables (Stripe Rhythm of Business: Weekly Business Reviews, Monthly Business Reviews, Quarterly Business Reviews). Shape the processes and go-to-market support model for a rapidly growing company, and make a tangible impact on sales and operations.

Responsibilities

  • Support the GTM leadership with intelligence and insight to accelerate growth
  • Support Sales Strategy and Operations colleagues by standardizing global and regional common process that is currently decentralized
  • Deep dive into key performance metrics and drive deep understanding of business performance
  • Problem solve and structure analysis outcomes for complex sales operations challenges through data, analytics and insight
  • Identify new opportunities and areas of productivity efficiency gains for Regional sales leadership
  • Participate in projects defining go-to-market approaches, as well as in regular business and resource planning
  • Run analysis on key performance metrics, providing relevant insights for managing the business
  • Oversee implementation of enabling systems and tools, working closely with internal systems teams
  • Prepare weekly senior leader forecast materials and provide ongoing updates on key business growth/metrics to leadership teams
  • Manage bespoke projects and effectively manage stakeholders

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • Has 7+ years of sales, strategy and operations experience in a high-tech growth environment, or operational experience in investment banking or management consulting or private equity or venture capital, or business insights / analytics roles
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL and other advanced analytics tools
  • Proficiency in BI visualization tools
  • Experience leveraging AI to analyze data / derive insights, automate processes, or create reports / dashboards
  • Has strong analytical skills and a structured approach to solving unique business problems. Has experience working with data and large data sets to identify trends and create insights to make recommendations to senior leaders
  • Has an enthusiastic “roll up your sleeves” mentality
  • Works well with a high degree of adaptability and flexibility in a fast paced, often ambiguous, and rapidly changing environment

Preferred qualifications

  • Prior experience at a growth stage Internet/software company
  • Prior experience in the payments industry
descriptions.job-11cxvkv:
The Team

The Global Desktop Support Team at Brevan Howard is a critical component of the firm’s technology platform, ensuring uninterrupted performance for portfolio managers, executives, and global users operating within a highly distributed, latency-sensitive hedge fund environment.

This London based role sits at the intersection of portfolio manager partnership, hands-on desktop support leadership, and strategic EUC contribution. Its primary purpose is the provision of high-class technical desktop support to portfolio managers, underpinned by day-to-day leadership of the London support engineers. It requires a highly credible, technically authoritative professional with a strong technical background gained specifically within the hedge fund industry, who understands the pace, pressure, and risk sensitivity of a hedge fund. Being credible in front of the C-suite is critical to the success of the candidate, who will interact daily with the Chief of Staff for Trading in both London and New York, alongside other senior stakeholders across the global business. The individual must appreciate the direct relationship between technology performance and P&L, operate with urgency during market hours, and always maintain absolute discretion.

The role demands someone who earns trust through competence, sound judgment, and consistent delivery. They must be a dependable and trusted source of technology support for senior leadership and portfolio managers, someone whose presence inspires confidence, and who is recognised as a trusted go-to member of the global Desktop Support team.

The primary mandate is to safeguard trading and leadership productivity. The role owns rapid response and resolution of issues impacting revenue-generating teams, delivering white-glove deskside and remote support with strict adherence to the 30-minute response SLA. Calm execution under pressure, proactive endpoint health management, and disciplined ServiceNow ticket hygiene are essential to minimizing downtime and eliminating operational friction.

Beyond operational support, this position carries strategic ownership of Enterprise User Computing (EUC) initiatives. The individual will be accountable for delivering key transformation programs across the firm’s in-house managed Windows 11 platform—ensuring structured execution, stakeholder alignment, risk mitigation, and zero trading disruption.

The role serves as the senior escalation point for complex end-user and desktop issues, driving root cause analysis and permanent remediation to eliminate repeat incidents. Success requires close coordination with infrastructure, networking, and security teams, alongside disciplined lifecycle ownership of incidents and continuous improvement initiatives.

A critical responsibility is the direct leadership of the London desktop support engineers. The successful candidate will lead, coach, and mentor the support engineer team on an ongoing basis, developing individual capability, addressing performance gaps, and elevating technical standards to ensure the team is resilient, skilled, and aligned to business demand.

The role also provides autonomy to contribute across broader infrastructure initiatives, influencing platform stability, automation, performance optimization, and service resilience beyond traditional desktop support.

This individual must be a visible, credible, and trusted presence in the London office—representing Technology with authority, integrity, and reliability, and acting as a trusted go-to member of the global Desktop Support team. Success will be measured not only by technical execution, but by the confidence senior leadership places in their judgment, discretion, and ability to consistently deliver in a high-performance hedge fund environment.

Main Duties/Responsibilities of the Role
Tier 1: Executive & Portfolio Manager Technology Partnership (Priority Focus) Mandate: Protect P&L, preserve trading continuity, and operate as a trusted technology advisor in a hedge fund environment.
  • Serve as the resolute technology partner to senior executives and portfolio managers in London, ensuring uninterrupted trading and leadership productivity.
  • Operate with a clear understanding of hedge fund market dynamics, urgency during trading hours, and the direct impact of downtime on performance.
  • Maintain daily credibility and engagement with C-suite stakeholders, including regular interaction with the Chief of Staff for Trading in both London and New York.
  • Deliver white-glove deskside and remote support with immediate triage and ownership through resolution.
  • Adhere strictly to the 30-minute SLA for portfolio managers, with disciplined communication and accountability.
  • Proactively monitor endpoint performance, trading application stability, and infrastructure readiness to prevent disruption before market impact.
  • Function as a credible and trusted source of technical guidance, demonstrating discretion, sound judgment, and authority in all executive interactions.
  • Maintain rigorous ServiceNow ticket hygiene to ensure data integrity, SLA transparency, and service improvement insights.
  • Remove friction for senior stakeholders, enabling focus on investment performance rather than technology issues.

Tier 2: Support Engineer Team Leadership, EUC Ownership & Infrastructure Contribution Mandate: Lead the London desktop support engineers, own EUC strategy and execution, modernize the platform, and strengthen support capability.

  • Provide direct line management and leadership of the London-based support engineers, including workload allocation, coaching, performance management, and professional development.
  • Own and deliver strategic EUC initiatives within London, ensuring alignment with global standards and hedge fund operational requirements.
  • Own the ongoing performance, stability, and continuous improvement of the firm’s in-house managed Windows 11 platform for the London user base.
  • Serve as the senior escalation point for complex end-user and desktop incidents, driving root cause analysis and permanent remediation.
  • Enforce disciplined lifecycle ownership of all incidents and service requests within ServiceNow to improve transparency and performance metrics.
  • Leverage AI tooling — including Claude — and automation platforms as part of day-to-day support delivery to enhance the end-user experience, shifting from reactive support to initiative-taking remediation and endpoint optimization.
  • Provide direct leadership to the London desktop support engineers, coaching and mentoring the team on an ongoing basis, identifying capability gaps, and elevating standards to ensure a resilient, skilled team.
  • Establish clear operating standards, accountability models, and performance expectations aligned to a high-performance trading environment.
  • Contribute autonomously across broader infrastructure initiatives, influencing platform stability, automation, performance optimization, and service resilience beyond traditional EUC boundaries.
  • Build and maintain extensive collaboration and credibility with other Technology Infrastructure heads across the global business, ensuring the London desktop support function is closely aligned with wider infrastructure, security, and network strategy.
  • Work effectively within the peer group of 6 regional desktop support leads, sharing knowledge and best practice, and consistently operating with a single global mindset rather than a siloed, regional one.
  • Function as a visible, credible technology leader in the London office and a trusted go-to member of the global Desktop Support team, reinforcing trust through consistent execution and strategic contribution.

Work Experience and Background

Essential

Min 3 years’ desktop support experience gained specifically within a hedge fund or similarly demanding front-office trading environment, supporting portfolio managers and executives, with a strong understanding of executive level service expectations.

Technical Skills

  • Proven trade floor / white-glove VIP support experience gained specifically within a hedge fund environment; candidates from wider financial services will also be considered but hedge fund background is strongly preferred.
  • Strong ServiceNow incident and SLA management discipline with excellent ticket hygiene.
  • Strong service management oversight, with a clear understanding of ITIL-aligned incident, problem, and change management processes, and the ability to own and manage incidents through to resolution.
  • Advanced Microsoft Windows 11 endpoint support, with deep expertise in build, deployment, and enterprise management standards.
  • Strong Microsoft Intune expertise, including device enrolment, compliance and configuration policies, application deployment, and endpoint security management.
  • Active Directory administration including GPO management and user lifecycle controls.
  • Microsoft 365 administration
  • Strong VMware vSphere and Omnissa Horizon expertise within enterprise environments.
  • Experience supporting Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), including session host management, image builds, and end-user virtual desktop performance troubleshooting.
  • Strong networking fundamentals (WAN/LAN, DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP) with effective troubleshooting capability.
  • Experience supporting Bloomberg Terminal and other market data and front-office trading applications.
  • Understanding of endpoint build, software distribution, and client management architectures.
  • Familiarity with end-user experience monitoring tools and ITIL-based support frameworks.
  • Confident leveraging AI tooling, including Claude, as part of day-to-day support delivery to enhance the enduser experience — for example accelerating troubleshooting, automating routine tasks, and improving the speed and quality of communication with portfolio managers and executives.

Competencies

Executive Credibility & Discretion Demonstrates mature executive presence, sound judgment, and absolute discretion when supporting senior leadership and portfolio managers. Being credible in front of the C-suite is critical to success in this role, with daily interaction expected with the Chief of Staff for Trading in both London and New York. Operates as a trusted and dependable source of technology guidance.

Hedge Fund Commercial Awareness Understands the direct relationship between technology performance and P&L, drawing on a genuine, technically strong background built within the hedge fund industry rather than wider financial services alone. Maintains a zerodowntime mindset during market hours, prioritising issues based on trading and business impact.

Calm, Decisive Leadership Under Pressure Remains composed and authoritative in high-stakes, time-sensitive situations. Makes clear, risk-aware decisions that protect trading continuity and executive productivity.

Business-First Service Orientation Translates technical issues into clear business impact. Delivers frictionless, high-touch support aligned to strict 30- minute response SLA commitments for revenue generating stakeholders.

Trust-Building & Professional Presence Naturally professional, empathetic, and confident. Builds long-term trust with senior users while representing Technology with consistency, reliability, and integrity.

Escalation Authority & Analytical Strength Acts as the senior escalation point for complex EUC and infrastructure-related issues. Applies structured troubleshooting and root cause analysis to eliminate repeat incidents.

Disciplined Process Ownership Operates with rigorous attention to detail and checklist-driven execution, ensuring nothing is overlooked in executive support, migration programs, or infrastructure initiatives.

Accountability & Data Discipline Takes full ownership of incidents and initiatives through to completion, maintaining strict ServiceNow ticket hygiene to drive transparency, metrics integrity, and continuous improvement.

Strategic Mindset with Operational Execution Balances hands on delivery with ownership of strategic EUC initiatives. Demonstrates the ability to execute transformation programs while maintaining day-to-day service excellence.

Team Coach & Global Collaborator Coaches and mentors the team on an ongoing basis, elevating standards and accountability. Builds extensive collaboration and credibility with other Technology Infrastructure heads across the global business, and works effectively within the peer group of 6 regional desktop support leads with a single global mindset, collaborating seamlessly across global IT functions to ensure follow-the-sun consistency and resilience.

We are seeking an experienced Internal Audit Manager with forensic investigation experience to join our global internal audit function. This role will be responsible for leading end-to-end business audit engagements across business functions, as well as conducting fraud investigations and whistleblower cases.
The ideal candidate will combine strong audit fundamentals with investigative rigour — capable of both evaluating control environments and tracing irregularities to their root cause. Deep knowledge of financial services, cryptocurrency, or fintech is highly valued.

Business Audit
  • Plan and execute end-to-end risk-based audit engagements across operational, financial, and business functions
  • Evaluate the design and operating effectiveness of internal controls, identifying control gaps, policy violations, and process inefficiencies.
  • Draft high-quality audit reports that clearly communicate findings, root causes, business impact, and actionable recommendations to management and the Board.
  • Monitor remediation progress and drive timely closure of audit issues.
Forensic Investigation
  • Lead or support fraud investigations, ethics violations, and whistleblower cases — including evidence collection, interview planning, and forensic analysis of financial transactions.
  • Conduct deep-dive analyses of suspicious activities, tracing transaction flows, identifying anomalous patterns, and documenting evidence for management action
  • Prepare investigation reports suitable for management decision-making, disciplinary proceedings, or regulatory disclosure.
  • Collaborate with Legal, HR, and Compliance on sensitive investigations, maintaining strict confidentiality and chain-of-custody protocols.
Collaboration & Advisory
  • Partner with Compliance, Risk, Finance, and business teams to strengthen the control environment proactively.
  • Provide advisory input on policy design, process improvements, and anti-fraud controls.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Law, Business Administration, or related field.
  • CPA, CIA, CFE (Certified Fraud Examiner), or equivalent certification preferred.
  • Minimum 6 years of experience in internal audit, forensic investigation, or compliance within financial services, fintech, or cryptocurrency sectors.
  • Demonstrated experience conducting fraud investigations or forensic reviews, including evidence handling, interview techniques, and report writing.
  • Strong understanding of internal control frameworks, risk management practices, and IIA auditing standards.
  • Knowledge of cryptocurrency exchange operations, blockchain, and related regulatory frameworks is a strong plus.
  • Detail-oriented with excellent analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • Effective communication skills (written and verbal) with the ability to present complex findings clearly to senior management.
  • Proficient in Chinese and English for business usage.

Why Join Us
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment. 
Our benefits include:
- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
- Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.
